POL-RD-01 requires both establishment tests to pass, and both do (excess greater than 20% of optimal, and greater than 0.8 km absolute). Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs the threshold test and trip_record.actual_distance_km may not be cited for it; the two happen to agree here at 18.0 km, but the finding rests on the GPS artifact.

The computed deviation status is additionally MATERIAL: 80% of optimal exceeds the 50% material threshold in POL-RD-01 (the absolute 8.0 km limb is not additionally needed once the percentage limb fires). Materiality under POL-RD-01 is assessed on the excess REMAINING after adjustment, and even after the closure adjustment below the remaining excess of 4.4 km still exceeds both establishment tests against the adjusted optimal of 13.6 km. A material deviation also requires the driver_profile check in POL-RD-06.

The LTA closure advisory exonerates the driver only up to the POL-RD-03 cap, and the cap bites hard here. The advisory names the Pelton Canal Link eastbound connector, a segment the booked optimal route traverses, and its window 18:14-18:55 covers the whole trip, so the exoneration is engaged. The justified excess is the lesser of the measured 8.0 km or 1.30 x (shortest lawful alternative 12.0 km - booked optimal 10.0 km) + 1.00 km tolerance = 3.60 km. So 3.60 km is exonerated and the remaining 4.4 km of excess is not, and is refundable under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted optimal of 13.6 km.

The driver did not merely take the diversion the closure required. The advisory itself records the shortest lawful route between the booked endpoints as 12.0 km, while the vehicle covered 18.0 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff: 6.0 km further than the lawful alternative and 4.4 km further than even the capped exoneration allows. POL-RD-03 caps exoneration on ADDITIONAL distance for exactly this reason - a closure explanation cannot be stretched to cover any distance a driver chooses to run.

Running POL-RD-02 against the closure-adjusted optimal route gives the refund arithmetically. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.6 + 0.28 x 27.2) x surge 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route = 23.416. Refund = charged_total 31.42 - 23.416 = 8.004, and the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 is 8.05. To both parties — this is a partial refund.

Agreed and on the record: an LTA advisory (EV-ADVIS-09113-01) closed the Pelton Canal Link eastbound connector, the segment the booked optimal route used, from 18:14 to 18:55 on 20 September 2026, covering this trip, and it records the shortest lawful alternative between the booked endpoints as 12.0 km. The driver took the signed industrial diversion and told the rider at 18:22:40; the rider replied at 18:23:10, 'please take the lawful diversion.'

1. Deviation established (POL-RD-01). The GPS trace governs: 18.0 km (EV-GPS-09113 trace_distance_km) against the booked optimal of 10.0 km (EV-TRIP-09113) is an excess of 8.0 km and 80%, passing both tests. The trip_record's rounded copy happens to agree; that does not change which field decides.

2. The closure excuses only part of it (POL-RD-03). The advisory names a road the optimal route traverses and its window covers the trip, so the driver is exonerated — but the exoneration is capped at the lesser of the measured excess (8.0 km) and 1.30 x (12.0 - 10.0) + 1.00 = 3.60 km. So 3.60 km is excused and 4.40 km is not. The closure-adjusted optimal is 10.0 + 3.60 = 13.60 km, and its duration is 20.0 x 13.60/10.0 = 27.2 min. The driver's claim to that effect is accepted; the rider's point that 18.0 km exceeds even the 12.0 km lawful alternative is also accepted — it is exactly why the cap bites.

3. The refund is arithmetic (POL-RD-02). recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.60 + 0.28 x 27.2) x 1.0, the multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (EV-FARE-09113), + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route = 23.416. Charged_total is 31.42 (EV-FARE-09113). Refund = 31.42 - 23.416 = 8.004, rounded up to SGD 8.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 25.5% of charged_total, far below the 90% that would force a full refund.

4. The off-route gantry is not added again (POL-RD-09(1)). The SGD 2.80 charged at the 'Industrial loop exit' gantry, which is off the optimal route, is already comprehended inside the SGD 8.05, exactly as both sides say; adding it would double-count the same money.

5. One fare line is a billing error (POL-RD-09(4)). The SGD 1.00 charged at the 'Pelton lawful diversion entry' gantry is a charge for a gantry this trip's GPS trace never passes: of the 205 fixes, the nearest comes 834.18 m from the gantry, well outside the 250 m match radius the clause prescribes. 6. No repeat-deviation uplift, no conduct referral (POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01). driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610 — the trailing-window counters the clause names, not the lifetime prior_deviation_flags. Neither limb of the pattern test is met. (Materiality is assessed on the excess remaining after adjustment, 4.40 km, which is 32% of the 13.60 km adjusted optimal and below the 8.0 km absolute limb, so the deviation is established but not material; even on the unadjusted 80% the profile check returns clean, so nothing turns on it. The rider's assertion of materiality is corrected on that basis.)

7. No rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04). The rider's message names no road or place and carries waypoint_hint null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable; in any event the instruction authorised only the 12.0 km lawful diversion, not 18.0 km.

8. No escalation (POL-RD-10). The trace is unimpaired — 205 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, maximum gap 0.0 s — so POL-RD-07 limbs (a)-(c) and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged; the identifier TRP-09113 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the refund is below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total; and the only fare line without a trace crossing is the one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) expressly excludes.

9. No relocation (POL-RD-05): pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so the booked optimal, as adjusted by POL-RD-03, is the baseline.

Outcome: the SGD 8.05 you contested is returned in full, and SGD 1.00 more is returned as the billing correction — SGD 9.05 in total. Confidence is 0.90; the deciding facts are carried by artifacts all at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-09113, EV-TRIP-09113, EV-FARE-09113 and EV-ADVIS-09113-01), so the cap is 1.0, and no POL-GEN-02 discount applies.
